description_en: Executes an SQL statement on a specified database by calling the ExecuteStatement operation
description_zh: 调用ExecuteStatement接口对指定数据库执行SQL语句
kebab_example: aliyun rds-data execute-statement --secret-arn acs:rds-api:cn-hangzhou:1266348003000000:rds-db-credentials/mySecret-Uy0000 --resource-arn acs:rds:cn-hangzhou:1266348003000000:dbinstance/rm-1234567890abc0000 --database test --continue-after-timeout true --format-records-as JSON --include-result-metadata true --sql select_0_from_users --transaction-id 86090000-94e1-45ce-8e25-354e3dd80000 --parameters '["example-string"]' --result-set-options LongReturnType=STRING DecimalReturnType=STRING --region cn-hangzhou
name: ExecuteStatement

parameters.help_en: The user credential of the Data API account. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/446624.html operation to obtain the value of this parameter. Format: `acs:rds:{{region}}:{{accountId}}:rds-db-credentials/{{secretName}}-{{6 digits random string}}`
parameters.help_zh: Data API账号的用户凭证，您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/446624.html接口获取该参数的值。格式如下：0
parameters.name: secret_arn

parameters.help_en:
The resource ARN that points to the resource that the user wants to access. Format: ```acs:rds:{{regionId}}:{{accountId}}:dbinstance/{{instanceId}}```

Parameter description:

regionId: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/446624.html operation to obtain this value.
accountId: The Alibaba Cloud account ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/446624.html operation to obtain this value.
instanceId: The instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
用于指向用户希望访问的资源，格式如下：```acs:rds:{{regionId}}:{{accountId}}:dbinstance/{{instanceId}}```

参数说明如下：

regionId：地域ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/446624.html接口获取。
accountId：阿里云账号ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/446624.html接口获取。
instanceId：实例ID
parameters.name: resource_arn

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to continue running the SQL statement if the call times out. Valid values:

true: Continue running.
false: Stop running.

By default, the SQL statement stops running after the call times out
parameters.help_zh:
如果调用超时，选择是否继续运行SQL语句，取值如下：

true：继续运行
false：停止运行

默认情况下，SQL语句在调用超时后停止运行
parameters.name: continue_after_timeout

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to format the result set as a single JSON string.

Only NONE or JSON can be specified.
Default value: NONE.
This parameter applies only to SELECT statements and is ignored for other types of statements.
The result is returned in formattedRecords
parameters.help_zh:
是否将结果集格式化为单个JSON字符串。

仅允许传入NONE或JSON。
默认值为NONE。
此参数仅适用于SELECT语句，对于其他类型的语句将被忽略。
结果将返回在formattedRecords中
parameters.name: format_records_as

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to include metadata in the result. Valid values:

true: Include metadata.
false: Do not include metadata
parameters.help_zh:
是否在结果中包含元数据的值，取值如下：

true：包含
false：不包含
parameters.name: include_result_metadata

parameters.help_en: The ID of the transaction that has been started. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/446897.html operation to obtain the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 已启动的事务ID，您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/446897.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: transaction_id

DATE

DECIMAL

JSON

DATE

fields.help_en: The byte stream encoded in Base64 format
fields.name: blob_value

fields.help_en:
Indicates whether the field value is null. Valid values:

true: The field value is null.

false: The field value is not null
fields.help_zh:
字段是否为空值，各取值含义如下：

true：为空值。

false：不为空值
fields.name: is_null

parameters.help_en: The details of the parameters for the SQL statement to execute
parameters.help_zh: 待执行SQL语句的参数详情

fields.help_en:
The data type that is allowed for display after a DECIMAL value is returned.

STRING: Converts the field to a String value.
DOUBLE_OR_LONG: Converts the field to a Long value if its scale is 0. Otherwise, converts the field to a Double value
fields.help_zh:
指定DECIMAL类型返回后，允许显示的数据类型。

STRING：将字段转换为String值。
DOUBLE_OR_LONG：如果它的scale为0，则将字段转换为Long值，否则转换为Double值
fields.name: decimal_return_type

fields.help_en:
The data type that is allowed for display after a LONG value is returned.

Valid values: LONG and STRING.
Default value: LONG.
If the length or precision of the value may cause truncation or rounding errors, specify STRING
fields.help_zh:
指定LONG类型返回后，允许显示的数据类型。

允许取值为LONG或STRING。
默认值为LONG。
如果数值的长度或精度可能导致截断或舍入错误，建议请指定STRING
fields.name: long_return_type
